name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
cues: Support your weight on the arm pads with your back on the backrest
Let your legs hang straight below you
Raise your knees above hip height
Tilt your pelvis up at the top

qa.note: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated ok by the lane review, auto-approved. ok: Forearms on the pads, closed neutral fists on the handles, back on the pad. Knees go from 8-10 deg hanging to hip 100 + posterior pelvic tilt 20 + lumbar flexion 18 at the top (thigh ~30 deg above horizontal, matching 'tilt your pelvis up'). Feet clear the floor by 107 mm. They hang at |x| 0.15 m, inside the side steps (inner edge |x| 0.23, y 0.36), so there is no foot/step overlap despite how the hero projects.
